visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a small curl on his forehead looks directly into the camera lens with a calm expression. He wears a clean white crew-neck T-shirt and a layered silver necklace featuring a distinctive padlock pendant. The setting is a minimalist, modern indoor living space with a blurred, softly lit background. (2) The man holds a silver chain necklace horizontally with both hands. This piece features numerous small silver beads hanging from the links. He positions the chain across his face, resting it over the bridge of his nose to show the dangling beads against his skin for a close-up visual detail. (3) He brings two identical black square jewelry boxes into the frame, held side by side. The logo 'GOTI' is printed in white on the lids. He smiles at the camera, conveying a sense of enthusiasm and satisfaction while showcasing the brand's packaging to the viewers. (4) He opens one of the black boxes to reveal a dark grey drawstring pouch inside. He carefully extracts a silver necklace with a rectangular perfume-bottle-shaped pendant. Using his fingers, he demonstrates that the small silver cap can be unscrewed and detached, revealing a functional miniature opening. (5) The man wears both silver necklaces simultaneously to demonstrate a layered styling approach. He poses for the camera with various hand-to-face gestures, including touching his chin and temple, while adjusting the jewelry. The lighting remains bright and consistent, highlighting the metallic sheen of the silver pieces.
